anchor_value: USD-denominated schedule columns marked with dollar signs
rationale: FX03 flagged cost_currency value U_USD as not USD, but the raw Schedule of Investments presents the valuation columns with dollar signs. Representative holding row 5:4 and the total investments row 7:35 both show amortized cost/fair value amounts as dollar-denominated. The defect is in interpreting the XBRL unit label U_USD as foreign/non-USD, not in the source valuation data.
